critical_code_review_comments: utils/device_limits.py enforce_or_warn(): when count>=cap AND replace_session_id is provided, if revoke succeeds but new_count is still >= cap (user has many stale sessions from warn-mode rollout), the response falls through to action='warn' with replaced=None — silently swallowing the successful revoke. Consider always returning replaced=sid when revoke succeeded, independent of new_count vs cap. Not blocking; only shows up when a user already has more sessions than the cap allows.
